differs: A reef in the sky, long since bleached: islands of snow over calcite, soft with drifts of snow, grown with branching trees, claws and mushrooms of dead grey coral and bone-white coral skeletons, hung with dead fans, a few end rods glowing pale among the branches, all in a close white mist where ash drifts and faint motes of light hang in the air, the clouds passing at island height.
